sections.description: Feature comments, browse discussion topics, sort reviews, collect reader media and votes, and send consent-based direct-reply emails.
sections.changelog:
= 0.15.2 =
* Receive the licensing connection through the existing GitHub updater. Connect once under Settings → MTT updates for future official updates; installed features keep working.
* Show a clear connection status, shorter setup help and update access for installed plugins only.

= 0.15.1 =
* Use the shared MTT admin UI library for consistent controls, layouts and keyboard focus.

* Report protected update outcomes through the shared website connection without sending content or credentials.

= 0.15.0 =
* Share one website key across MTT plugins with encrypted storage and manual site approval.
* Protect official update delivery while keeping installed features working.

= 0.11.0 =
* Keep review ratings consistent across sorting, summaries and reader media, including imported duplicates.
* Reduce background database work and pause unused AI indexing while preserving saved analyses.
* Load public scripts and styles only for the comment features shown on the page.
* Save related Topics and Appearance settings together with one Save changes action.
* Share reply-engine maintenance with Reply Notifications while preserving subscriptions, email settings and signed links.

= 0.10.2 =
* Refresh sorting, search, filters and pagination without reloading the full post, with faster returns to recently viewed results.
* Preserve comment drafts, uploads and keyboard focus during refreshes; respect reduced motion.
* Improve Recommended sorting performance while retaining rating priority and complete reply threads. Keep native links as fallbacks.

= 0.10.1 =
* Add the shared MTT brand mark to the settings heading with local assets and reserved dimensions.
* Retain media upload controls and the single filter-reset behavior from the newer client-tested builds.
* Group reply settings into Comment form, Email design, and Delivery & data with one Save changes button and preserved drafts.
* Add editable checkbox label/helper text, neutral appearance controls, and a live checkbox preview using the public renderer.
* Add the MTT brand mark to the settings heading.
* Organize reply settings into tabs that preserve drafts, with one Save changes button.
* Add editable checkbox text, appearance controls and a live preview; retain media controls and the single filter-reset action.

= 0.10.0 =
* Add a styled comment opt-in with configurable label, optional helper text, color, size and native-control alternative.
* Preview unsaved checkbox changes beside the controls without saving settings or sending email.
* Organize Comment form, Email design, and Delivery & data into accessible tabs with one Save changes action that preserves edits across tabs.
* Inherit theme typography, retain theme overrides, and preserve subscription and email-branding data.

= 0.9.6 =
* Bring the Zoha reply fixes into the current Modern Comments build while retaining media controls and filter improvements.
* Activate checked guest and member opt-ins immediately, without confirmation email; retain address-change verification and unsubscribe safeguards.
* Recover up to 20 recent approved direct replies after explicit confirmation of an existing pending request, preserving identity, moderation and duplicate-delivery checks.

= 0.9.4 =
* Keep one Clear filters action for topic, search, rating and media filters; remove the redundant Clear topic link.
* After explicit guest confirmation, queue up to 20 recent approved direct replies posted while the current subscription was pending.
* Preserve moderation, self-reply suppression, unsubscribe checks, identity boundaries and idempotent delivery; do not send catch-up mail during upgrades.

= 0.9.3 =
* Add administrator photo and video upload switches under Comments → Modern Comments → Media.
* Enforce disabled uploads on the server and skip uploader assets when photos are off, while retaining published media and moderation.
* Preserve existing upload behavior until settings are saved.

= 0.9.2 =
* Rename the plugin display name and Comments submenu to Modern Comments, part of the MTT Engagement Suite; preserve existing identifiers and saved data.
* Shorten the setup guide and move detailed behavior and developer guidance into the developer reference.
* Document the lightweight standalone Featured Comments option.

= 0.9.1 =
* Match the space above the review filter labels to the space below the inputs when no reader media gallery appears below the rating summary.

= 0.9.0 =
* Add an off-by-default Modernize comment form setting with theme-preserving layout and copy refinements.
* Keep guest details together and move existing MTT reply consent after the visible uploader, immediately before submit, in native keyboard order.
* Preserve WordPress submission/reply behavior, guest consent and identity requirements, extension fields, and original Tasty Recipes / WP Recipe Maker rating controls.

= 0.8.3 =
* Keep the shorter comment prompt next to the textarea label and simplify reply-notification guidance while preserving custom consent labels.
* Simplify upload guidance and keep format, size and duration limits in an accessible File requirements disclosure.
* Reveal the optional photo description only after a photo is selected, with an example and an explanation of its accessibility purpose. Preserve native controls without JavaScript.

= 0.8.2 =
* Show topic chips with thread counts, an explicit selected state and topic-only clearing; preserve other filters when switching topics. Use a whole-chip hover surface rather than underlining the label and count.
* Highlight matching topic phrases in approved public comments and replies while preserving formatting and stored content.
* Add on-demand potential-topic discovery from a bounded sample of approved public reader threads, with frequency counts and example comment links.
* Present candidates in responsive cards with thread-count badges, collapsible results, Added states and explicit edit links.
* Let administrators review candidates in the editable library before saving; retain existing topics and avoid external services or frontend scanning.

= 0.8.1 =
* Add shared, pseudonymous audience events with deduplication, 90-day retention and WordPress privacy export/erasure.

= 0.8.0 =
* Integrate reply subscriptions, confirmation/unsubscribe actions, branded email previews and delivery administration into the comment system.
* Preserve existing consent, queue records, signing keys and email settings; pause the standalone engine when both plugins are active.
* Keep reply notifications disabled on new sites until an administrator enables them.
* Retain the shorter reply opt-in label and helper text, including existing default labels, while preserving custom consent wording.

= 0.7.1 =
* Add an administrator-owned topic library with editable labels, keyword lists, custom topics and enable/remove controls.
* Group settings into native WordPress Topics, Appearance and Analysis navigation with consistent cards and compact, keyboard-accessible topic editors.
* Refresh cached suggestions after library changes while retaining stable topic IDs and all comments.
* Refresh cached suggestions after library changes while preserving comments and stable topic IDs.

= 0.7.0 =
* Add cached suggested discussion topics with synonym matching, distinct-thread thresholds, accessible filtering and resumable background indexing.
* Add independent topic settings and an administrator-only cache-clear action; invalidate suggestions after comment changes and support page-cache adapters.

= 0.6.0 =
* Add a versioned featured-comment template with child-theme, parent-theme and plugin fallback rendering.
* Document portable theme styling, overrides, AJAX contracts and upgrade checks; keep selection and moderation in the plugin.

= 0.5.9 =
* Add debounced AJAX search as readers type, keeping focus and comment drafts intact.
* Keep filter recovery available for empty searches and ignore superseded requests.
* Combine the cache and access work with the existing featured-review and uploader improvements.

= 0.5.8 =
* Place the shared media uploader after comment fields and before submission for visitors and logged-in users.

= 0.5.7 =
* Add native Feature/Unfeature controls beneath approved comments on recipe pages for users with per-comment editing permission. Reuse the protected editorial POST handler; visitors and subscribers see no controls.

= 0.5.6 =
* Add a plain-text `mtt_ch_featured_label` filter for theme-owned editorial badge wording, with escaped output and a Featured fallback.

= 0.5.5 =
* Show approved featured-review photos and video posters through the shared media renderer and accessible viewer. Keep badge customization in theme CSS or WordPress Additional CSS.
* Cache public search matches, rating summaries, and helpful-vote totals across requests, including hosts without persistent object caching.
* Invalidate affected posts after comment, rating, editorial, and vote changes; bound search storage and reject stale concurrent results.

= 0.5.4 =
* Highlight editorially featured comments with a Featured badge and a lightly tinted theme-accent card above the first Recommended results. Add an optional featured-background Appearance override.
* Add provider-independent Pro/Elite feature entitlements with server-side checks and unchanged access for unmanaged sites.
* Preserve published review media and moderation after access changes; isolate ranked query caches by effective access.

= 0.5.3 =
* Inset filter dropdown chevrons with reserved text space, RTL support and native high-contrast fallback.

= 0.5.2 =
* Unify public control styling with shared primary, outline and quiet variants, theme branding, visible focus and 44px button targets.
* Add mouse drag and release momentum to reader media; preserve native touch scrolling, reduced motion, keyboard controls and ordinary links.
* Isolate carousel lifecycle and dispose animations, listeners and resize observers before AJAX replacement. Initialize preserved native uploaders only once.

= 0.5.1 =
* Combine photos and video in one FilePond picker, preserving native submission and independent server validation.
* Inherit theme typography and Global Styles, with optional native Appearance settings for colors and corner radius; keep appearance independent of AI.

= 0.5.0 =
* Add whole-thread comment search, rating/media filters, a reader-rating breakdown, and a compact responsive review hub.
* Add moderated short video uploads with bounded local conversion, metadata removal, poster generation, captions, and click-to-play viewing.
* Add a recipe-tips prompt without another required field or checkbox.

= 0.4.1 =
* Replace the gallery disclosure with an always-visible, swipeable photo carousel, cover-photo star ratings, and accessible previous/next controls. Keep review details in the photo viewer.

= 0.4.0 =
* Add a See all photos gallery of approved photo reviews across comment pages, with review excerpts, ratings, and stable links to each thread.
* Add bounded gallery pagination, AJAX enhancement, and previous/next photo controls in the closable viewer.

= 0.3.3 =
* Open review photos in a native modal with a visible Close button, Escape/backdrop dismissal, and focus restoration. Keep standard image links as the no-JavaScript fallback.

= 0.3.2 =
* Remove the recipe-made checkbox and public declaration label to simplify the form. Preserve existing metadata; ratings, recommendations, photo uploads, and subscriptions are unchanged.

= 0.3.1 =
* Use pinned FilePond 4.x with image previews, removable selections, drag-and-drop, and file validation. Bundle MIT-licensed runtime assets locally; preserve native form submission, server validation, moderation, and the no-JavaScript fallback.

= 0.3.0 =
* Add progressive AJAX comment sorting and pagination with crawlable URLs, browser history, draft preservation, and full-page fallbacks.
* Rename the public rating sort to Recommended and add Feather thumbs-up/down votes with change/clear controls.
* Improve the recipe-made field and add bounded, re-encoded photo reviews with native comment moderation and photo removal controls.

= 0.2.0 =
* Default to existing recipe ratings without AI, with chronological fallback on unrated posts and stable thread pagination.
* Add nonce-protected helpful voting with duplicate protection, undo, and rate limiting; votes break ties within star ratings.
* Add an optional reader-declared “I made this recipe” field while preserving provider ratings, schema, and saved AI functionality.

= 0.1.0 =
* Add editorial picks, a single featured card, and thread-aware Recommended/Newest/Oldest ordering.
* Add queued native WordPress AI analysis, monthly reconciliation, and optional local browser analysis with quality gates.
* Preserve legacy featured selections and provide authenticated controls, portable styling, and disposable-site regression coverage.

= 0.9.5 =
* Activate checked comment-form opt-ins immediately for guests and members, without a confirmation email.
* Preserve unchecked choices, unsubscribe links, moderation checks and address-change verification.
